_meta.purpose: The subjects Beatty Secondary offers, and at which levels, keyed by Paths subject ids. Set levels shows these first; every other school's subjects sit behind More subjects.
_meta.parity: Mirrors e21cclog/school/beatty.json (id beatty-2027) in the E21CC Log, built from the same message. Keep the two in step: a subject or level changed here changes there.
_meta.notes: Levels are the levels Beatty runs. `elsewhere` marks levels taught at another school or centre. Subjects not listed here are not offered at Beatty; they stay available under More subjects for transfers and other schools.

mtl.note: Chinese, Malay or Tamil Language at Beatty. Other Mother Tongue Languages are taught outside school, at G2 or G3.

hmtl.note: Higher Chinese, Higher Malay or Higher Tamil Language.

chemistry.note: Taken with Physics or with Biology.

computing.note: G1 at Beatty, first for students without a fifth subject. G3 at another school or centre.

lower.humanities: At G1, Geography, History and Literature in English are taught as the Humanities Exposure Modules. A move to G2 is made one subject at a time.

upper.science: Pure Sciences: Chemistry with Physics, or Chemistry with Biology. Combined Sciences: Science (Physics, Chemistry) at G2 or G3, or Science (Chemistry, Biology) at G3.
upper.humanities: Social Studies at G1 is taken without an exam.

upper: Social Studies at G1, not examined
